surfBiteReport: The most current readable report found for this stretch is from noeoutdoors.com, dated approximately mid-July 2026 (roughly three weeks old). Along the PCB and adjacent Gulf-front beaches, the surf bite was described as steady, with Spanish mackerel, whiting, redfish, and jack crevalle showing up along the shoreline, particularly during the first and last couple hours of daylight when baitfish schools push close to shore. Water temp today measured at 85°F. The tactic that was producing: targeting the deeper troughs and cuts between sandbars rather than casting to open water, and watching for diving birds or jumping bait before picking a spot. Sargassum grass was variable beach to beach, so moving to find cleaner water made a significant difference in results.
